definitions.explanation: A person who works in government administration, especially high-ranking officials.
The system of government officials and their practices.

examples.japanese: {高級|こうきゅう}{官僚|かんりょう}
{官僚|かんりょう}{主義|しゅぎ}が{問題|もんだい}だ。
{彼|かれ}は{長年|ながねん}{官僚|かんりょう}として{働|はたら}いた{後|あと}、{政治家|せいじか}に{転身|てんしん}した。
examples.english: After working as a bureaucrat for many years, he switched careers to become a politician.

notes:
{官僚|かんりょう} refers to government officials.

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {官僚|かんりょう}{制度|せいど} (bureaucratic system)
- {官僚|かんりょう}{主義|しゅぎ} (bureaucratism)
- {高級|こうきゅう}{官僚|かんりょう} (high-ranking official)
- {官僚|かんりょう}{機構|きこう} (bureaucratic apparatus)

RELATED:
- {公務員|こうむいん}: civil servant (broader term)
- {役人|やくにん}: government official (slightly informal)
